sourceState: Candidate was built from the uncommitted fixes on main; source hashes identify the tested files. Functional source did not change after the final candidate build.

internalAudio.scope: Native browser MediaStream generated by Web Audio; not a physical microphone test.

continuous.heapScope: Page JS heap only, sampled every 20 seconds starting partway through the run. Does not establish complete process, worker, GPU memory or listener counts.

accounting.note: Ledger tokens include conservative reservation for unknown usage, not a provider invoice. No retries or replacement calls. The same ledger was retained across model switches and rebuilds.

limitations: Seven observations are insufficient to certify production p95. Earlier-policy failures are reported separately, not removed from history.
Complete/partial describe accepted protocol items. Sampling disables AI after EOF and clears unshown queued items; not every accepted item was tested through final display.
Exact text deduplication and term-based grounding are not semantic correctness guarantees. Near paraphrases remain in the second piano request.
Four music recordings, one public speech recording and synthetic noise are a small coverage set; not a general genre or instrument accuracy benchmark.

hygiene.scope: Exact comparison with authorized current project/test credential values. No secret values or hashes are published. Not a Git history or credential revocation audit.

unpassedReleaseGates: Desktop 45 FPS in at least 95% of second windows (observed about 1.05%). Managed page focus/scheduling cause not isolated.
Final AI complete batches 4/7 and near-paraphrase quality; seven requests cannot certify production p95 or settle model/budget.
